titleText: JTF News: CBC News, BBC News
mainText: A fire in Bangkok resulted in 30 deaths, with investigation findings including locked doors and flammable decor.

Three people killed in Odesa during Russian bombing.

titleText: JTF News: ABC News Australia, CBC News
mainText: Cyclospora illnesses in the United States have reached a new record level, and Michigan officials are investigating lettuce as a possible source.
